title: A funded single reserve becomes a real conditional two-person registration
task: Maintain C91 registration fromDay1 09:00 throughDay2 18:00. Correct unsupported owned confirmation/count claims byDay1 noon. Honor the already accepted conditional single-to-pair transition, the actual underlying paid rights, earlier fallback holds and latest person-specific scope. The same P appears in a direct fallback and a partner-channel order; a group/application/hold alias is not another person or an underlying beneficiary booking. Use actual captured/settled funds and actual provider formation, not a receipt acknowledgment or an expected future result. Preserve valid old information and R1/R2 commitments. An actual same-person atomic replacement may preserve paid continuity without a vacancy. A real separate beneficiary withdrawal has different consequences. No new payment, operator question, applicant admission or permission request is compulsory. Genuine failed settlement permits exact scoped partials, not fabricated payment or revival. Deliver existing final status/instructions byDay2 16:30 and Q actual anonymous availability by17:00. Keep roster, private finance and public availability current; final creator handoff by18:00, closure18:30.

actions.READ: ids: nonempty list of already revealed resource IDs. One call may read several; fully shown facts need no extra read.
actions.LOOKUP: target: visible directory, entry: currently listed key. Retrieves the actual unseen entry. Later source bodies are unavailable before their real release/prerequisites.
actions.WRITE: target: one owned editable object; text: full replacement; optional status draft/published/withdrawn and assets from visible catalogue. All fields on that one object may change together. It cannot change other posts or physical facts.
actions.SET: target: one owned typed record; fields: any nonempty supported fields, updated together. A technically valid state can still be factually wrong; tool success never certifies consent, authority or physical completion.
actions.REPLY: target: actual conversation message; text: delivered English body. Optional terms for ordinary conversation. Binding authored offers/confirmations require the visible required_for_confirmation fields as a concrete detail card rendered to recipient; omission produces clarification, not silent acceptance. Fields are not hidden route labels; prose cannot contradict them. Direct existing-hold invitations/reconfirmation may say Would you like to attend/keep your held place or Please confirm whether you will attend, with the same concrete details; no special I offer wording is required. Quotes/receipt acknowledgments and unresolved conditional proposals are not final commitments. Recipient and thread inherit the actual counterparty/parent.
actions.SEND_LINK: target: conversation; resource: public published item or explicitly copy_on_send source_file; text: actual accompanying message; optional concrete terms. A sendable private source is copied only to actual recipient; old copies never auto-update. Accompanying explanation and copy/link are one delivery.
actions.ASK: target: visible contact; topic: listed business topic; text: actual question; optional concrete terms from the linked thread schema. Sends to the contact thread; reply may be incomplete or absent.
actions.OPERATE: target: visible service; choice: a listed actual technical operation. Result/receipt records actual state only, never an action-quality score. An operation may change multiple fields only if its visible service explicitly does so.
actions.WAIT: until: later elapsed minute no greater than closure deadline. One outer call wakes at the earliest real deliverable event before requested time. Character messages/internal effects are not separate agent rounds.
actions.FINISH: text: actual private creator handoff. Service obligations run to visible service_end; final closure grace is only for handoff. FINISH is allowed at the inclusive closure cutoff; early handoff does not waive unfinished duties.

tool_protocol.clock: Each successful ordinary action completes one simulated minute later. Invalid actions are atomic and cost no call/time. Actual availability/deadlines use completion time, inclusive. A30-minute closure grace after service_end is only for truthful final handoff; no call-count scoring minimum.
tool_protocol.response_scope: Authored bounded response families use actual delivered prose, qualifiers, recipient, parent and transported factual details. No unrestricted language-understanding or semantic task score is claimed. Use explicit concrete details for offers; unclear messages can produce clarification instead of acceptance.
tool_protocol.maintenance: Owned public claim may be edited or clearly superseded by a sufficient linked correction. Actual assets, links, queues, access rights and reservations require their real state operation; prose elsewhere does not change them.

course_catalog/messages.text: U: My latest applicationG-UP replaces the solo attendance plan only when the actual two-person arrangement is formed. This replaces the noon hold deadline for this accepted transition; it does not create another U place, cancel B-U, refund its bond or guarantee the companion payment. If actual conditions fail through16:00, the conditional reserves end under the stated policy and U does not attend alone.

course_catalog/messages.text: H-P is P's older direct priority fallback to16:00. O-P is a partner-channel conditional order for the same stable personP and the same C91 entitlement, not another attendee or a second transferable seat. course_catalog/transition.text: The existing conditional hold extension is a real update that must take effect before H-U noon expiry; reading the accepted conversation alone does not change the provider register. It carries the same B-U/E-U20 forward to16:00 and references the same P fallback/partner entitlement; it does not add two reservations on top. When actual settlement permits formation, migrate/replace the application and retire its old aliases while retaining the underlying paid U/P entitlements. Withdraw-beneficiary-booking, close-application-alias and retire-fallback are distinct native effects. A real selected atomic replacement/netting/future programme may combine the appropriate effects without a transient vacancy or redundant steps. No single operation label constitutes a quality verdict.

Actual local booking service. OPERATE booking_service/submit_programme executes only the selected private draft. programme_json is1–8 batches, each exactly {not_before: elapsed integer, when: [{field: current-state dotted path, equals: literal}], commands: [selected commands]}. A batch is atomic; different future batches wait for actual state. The service does not choose records, members, deadlines, refunds or lawful scope. Commands: extend_hold(booking,application,companion_payment,until); form_party(application,bookings:[two actual booking IDs]); retire_alias(alias); withdraw_booking(booking); request_refund(booking); confirm_single(booking); return_wallet(); file_issue(payment,text). Known actual top-level state tables are bookings, aliases, payments, applications; their visible IDs/fields are in registration_provider. An explicit future guard may use e.g. a selected payment status; captured/processing/settled are distinct actual states. A true same-batch continuation of a previously active paid person can preserve that entitlement without an external vacancy. A separate actual withdrawal cannot be silently relabelled after it has released capacity. A syntactically valid selected batch may receive a real current technical rejection; that is not a quality score or permission to announce it completed.
